description: The boolean operators B-AND/B-OR/B-XOR/B-NOT (boolean expressions, ISO 8.7.2/8.8.2; COMPUTE Format 2 14.9.8; boolean relation 8.8.4.2.2; simple boolean condition 8.8.4.3). 2002 introduction; the operator tiers are {is2002()}?-gated, so below 2002 the W1.5 parse-layer mapping names the edition (0900) and the words are user-defined. (Depends on boolean data - the source uses PIC 1 items.)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. BOOLOP1.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-A PIC 1(4) VALUE B"1100".
01 WS-B PIC 1(4) VALUE B"0101".
01 WS-R PIC 1(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    COMPUTE WS-R = WS-A B-AND WS-B.
    DISPLAY WS-R.
    STOP RUN.
